title: Nitro Forge brand theme
description: Rebrand contract. A brand sets accent, ink and soft for the dark and light schemes and nothing else. The six neutral keys are deferred until a contrast check exists (decision 23). Radius, status colours, paper and every scale are locked. Separate from tooling/brand/brand.schema.json (decision 24).

defaultDensity.description: Starting density. Users can still change it at runtime.

accent.description: Feeds --color-primary, --color-accent and --color-focus. Needs 3:1 against the raised surface as a focus ring.
